$comment: mobile-coding-agents project configuration. Every key is optional and shown with its default. `verifyGate`: notice (one line when a session ends with unverified source changes), require (the agent is sent back to run the checks), off. `prompts`: few (a person is asked only before publishing, signing changes, losing work or skipping checks), strict (also device data, installs, edits to CI and signing configuration, new suppressions). `verify` example: {"ios": {"quick": "xcodebuild build -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -quiet CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO", "test": "..."}}. Run `mobile verify --dry-run` to see what would run.
